verdict.rationale: Ollama runs local AI models, so on-device real-time speech transcription is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about audio input, dictation, or speech-to-text models. The mentions of local model execution, multimodal chat, and image generation do not show speech transcription, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
